title: Addressing "Documentation Debt" in Machine Learning Research: A Retrospective Datasheet for BookCorpus
findings: The paper found notable skews in religious representation in datasets related to BookCorpus. The broader smashwords.com collection appears to over-represent books about Christianity, while the BookCorpusOpen sample over-represents books about Islam. The authors note this is a limitation as the metadata indicates subject matter, not necessarily the author's viewpoint.
